neretü: nere — name; possessive -tü, 'having a name, named' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [名字有的]
nidün-düri: nidün — eye; dative-locative -dür, 'in the eye' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen; Ming 眼 + 自的行) [眼 自的行]
γaltu: γal — fire; possessive -tu, 'fire-having', 'with fire' (noun + possessive; Ming (火)有的) [(火)有的]
nutuγ-tur: nutuγ — camping-ground; dative-locative -tur, 'in the camp' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [營盤 裏]
eke-de: eke — mother; dative -de, 'to the mother' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [母 行]
abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
odba: od- — to go; past -ba, 'went' (verb, past tense) [去了]
